jei.colorist.magic_paper.info: Magic Paper can be used to extract color attributes from mobs. Use dyes or magic crystals on a Magic Table to enhance it.
jei.colorist.magic_book.info: The Magic Book stores color attributes. Insert magic paper into it via a Magic Table, then right-click to cast spells.
jei.colorist.magic_crystal.info: Magic Crystal is used to enhance magic paper and magic book attributes. Can be mined from Magic Crystal Ore.
modonomicon.colorist.guidebook.descripti: A beginner's guide to the Colorist mod.
modonomicon.colorist.guidebook.intro.tex: Colorist allows you to collect color attributes from mobs using Magic Paper, store them in a Magic Book, and cast powerful rainbow magic.
First, craft a Magic Paper and a Magic Book. Defeat mobs to collect color attributes. Insert the attributes into the book, then right-click to cast spells.
modonomicon.colorist.guidebook.magic_tab: The Magic Table is the core workstation of the Colorist. Right-click to place items in it, then use dyes or magic crystals to process them.
modonomicon.colorist.guidebook.magic_boo: The Magic Book can store up to 12 attributes. All attributes are combined into a composite attribute that affects damage, crit rate, and health bonus.
modonomicon.colorist.guidebook.magic_pap: Magic Paper is used to extract color attributes from mobs. Use it on mobs or let them drop it, then enhance it with dyes.
modonomicon.colorist.guidebook.dyes.text: The mod adds several dyes: Rainbow Dye, Grayscale Dye, Bleak Dye, and Soil Dye. They are used to dye Magic Paper or craft Magic Books.
modonomicon.colorist.guidebook.combat.te: Right-click with a Magic Book that has attributes to start a 10-tick cast. During casting, aim at entities to deal damage and trigger critical hits.
